preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 250,000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= 10**6 for a, b, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid vertices and have a positive integer weight.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.
Each output integer must represent a non-negative total weight of edges to be deleted.
At least one of the output integers must be greater than 0, except for the last one which can be 0.
